scope: Read-only corrected interface-compatibility audit between the frozen Selector v4 packed top and the actually existing Q8xQ8 PE16 DATAFLOW / PL-resident FFN cores. Correction is based on the actual Transformers 4.57.0 source, model.safetensors.index.json, and read-only safetensors headers. No GPU, no board, no synthesis, no bitstream, no source/RTL/HLS/driver modification, no network.

correction_record.reason: The first 2026-09-28 audit assumed three independent vision Q/K/V projections and treated FFN fc1 as a direct selector boundary, which is false for the real Qwen3-VL vision tower.

changes.was: Q/K/V are three independent q_proj/k_proj/v_proj Linear weights
changes.corrected: Qwen3VLVisionAttention has a single fused attn.qkv Linear[1024->3072] with bias, plus attn.proj Linear[1024->1024] with bias; no independent Q/K/V tensors exist
changes.evidence: modeling_qwen3_vl.py:175-176; index/header contain only blocks.N.attn.qkv.{weight,bias} and blocks.N.attn.proj.{weight,bias}

changes.was: selector segment 0 can feed qkv/fc1 directly with only an x_scale=1/s broadcast adapter
changes.corrected: selector segment 0 is the block0 residual hidden; block1 starts with norm1 LayerNorm, then fused QKV. A 1/s broadcast is only a dequant adapter and is NOT equivalent to LayerNorm.

changes.was: fc1 is a direct selector boundary
changes.corrected: fc1 input is norm2(hidden + attn(...)); the full attention path and a residual plus norm2 lie in between, so fc1 is not a direct boundary

changes.was: a scale broadcast adapter is sufficient
changes.corrected: a Dequant(global s) -> LayerNorm(norm1, eps=1e-6) -> Q8_0 requant chain is required; the existing pl_resident_ffn LayerNorm-Q8_0 core takes 4xfp32/128-bit, not selector int8, so an int8->fp32 adapter or a new int8-LayerNorm-Q8_0 variant is needed

changes.was: downstream can be treated as GEMM-only
changes.corrected: after QKV GEMM the 3072 bias add, reshape/split, RoPE, softmax, PV, proj+bias, residual, norm2, fc1/gelu/fc2 are all still required and do not exist on the PL side; downstream completeness may not be claimed

header_only_read.method: read 8-byte little-endian header length N, then JSON header, then data_offsets; no full model load

slice_check.note: read first 4 BF16 values of four block1 tensors; proves header+slice read path and dtype only, NOT a numerical/error verification

block.forward: hidden = hidden + attn(norm1(hidden)); hidden = hidden + mlp(norm2(hidden))

rope.note: rotates Q and K only, cos/sin from vision axial RoPE

selector_contract.segment0: tokens_int8: [K,4,1024] int8, group-major patch-minor, 128-bit little-endian packed lanes

global_scale.definition: x_real ~= q / s ; q = clamp(round(x_real * s), -128, 127); zero-point 0
global_scale.scope: one global symmetric float s shared by the whole tensor, passed through scale_in -> scale_out, not in any output segment
global_scale.dequant_broadcast: filling activations_scale with the constant 1/s makes q8q8 compute x_dequant = q * (1/s) = q/s, i.e. a correct DEQUANT of the selector int8
global_scale.not_layernorm: the 1/s broadcast is elementwise linear scaling with no mean/variance, no centering, no normalization, and no norm1.weight/bias; it is NOT equivalent to LayerNorm and must not be claimed as such

q8q8_pe16_dataflow_hls.quant: GGML Q8_0 per-32 int8 block with binary16 scale, weights and activations
q8q8_pe16_dataflow_hls.bias_note: signature q8q8_gemm(weights_q, weights_scale, activations_q, activations_scale, output, m, n, k) has no bias; contribution = dot * weight_scale * activation_scale only (q8q8_gemm.cpp:181-186)

q8q8_pe16_hls.note: board-validated PE16 baseline; same interface as DATAFLOW; also has no bias

q8q8_pe8_family.note: same Q8_0 block layout; no bias

q8q8_gemv_stream6_hls.judgement: INCOMPATIBLE for vision prefill: decoder M=1 GEMV

q8_output.quant: d = amax/127; q = round(x/d) clamped to [-127,127]

pl_resident_ffn_hls.adapter_gap: selector provides int8 + one global float s; this core needs 4xfp32/128b. Need an int8-global-scale -> fp32 adapter before LayerNorm, or a new direct int8 LayerNorm-Q8_0 variant.

compatibility.boundary: Selector segment0 -> Dequant(global s) -> LayerNorm(norm1, eps=1e-6) -> Q8_0 requant -> fused QKV GEMM -> +qkv.bias
compatibility.activation_scale: LayerNorm output must be RE-QUANTIZED to per-32 Q8_0; the selector global 1/s broadcast alone is not sufficient
compatibility.bias: must be added by a new operator; q8q8 has no bias
compatibility.weight_quant: needs Q8_0 vision weights; only BF16 safetensors exist in-repo

compatibility.reason: the model has a single fused attn.qkv Linear; no independent Q/K/V tensors exist
fc1 input is norm2(hidden + attn(norm1(hidden))); a full attention path plus residual plus norm2 lie in between
input is the attention output, not selector segment0

hard_new_ops_required: int8-global-scale -> fp32 dequant adapter (or direct int8 LayerNorm-Q8_0 variant)
Q/K/V reshape+split, RoPE, softmax, PV, proj+bias, residuals, norm2, fc1/gelu/fc2

zero_return_assessment.placement: J_F_CONTINUE (score on Jetson, selector on FPGA, K tokens stay on FPGA, real FPGA downstream core)
zero_return_assessment.corrected_requirement: Even the shared-DDR / shared-onchip zero-return path must insert an int8->fp32(global s)->LayerNorm->Q8_0 elementwise chain plus a bias add between selector and Q8Q8; it is no longer a single-buffer selector-write/GEMM-read relationship.
zero_return_assessment.true_zero_materialization: requires option C (AXI4-Stream variant + width/FIFO adapter) which does not exist
zero_return_assessment.missing_measured_term: T_fpga_downstream unmeasured; no selector+downstream full-system chain exists

minimal_candidate.boundary: Selector-style int8(global s) -> Dequant -> LayerNorm(norm1, eps=1e-6) -> Q8_0 -> Q8Q8(M=4K,N=3072,K=1024) -> +qkv.bias
minimal_candidate.input_evidence: real block1 norm1/qkv small slice from header data_offsets, or a streaming read of one real full layer; no whole-model load
minimal_candidate.reference: BF16/FP32 F.linear (torch or numpy float32) over the same real weights

blockers: Model topology: selector segment0 is the block0 residual hidden and must pass norm1 LayerNorm before fused QKV; skipping it is model-incorrect
No int8-global-scale input path: pl_resident_ffn LayerNorm-Q8_0 core takes 4xfp32/128-bit, not selector int8; need an adapter or a new int8 variant
q8q8 GEMM has no bias: the fused QKV [3072] bias has no PL operator to add it
Vision Q8_0 weights do not exist (only BF16 safetensors in-repo)
PL side lacks attention/RoPE/softmax/PV, so the downstream after +qkv.bias is incomplete
No selector<->downstream BD/driver and no AXI4-Stream data plane
T_fpga_downstream unmeasured; selector has only OOC route + 3-case cosim, no bitstream/board signoff
warnings: Selector int8 clamps to [-128,127] (quantization_contract.md:11) while pl_resident_ffn quantize clamps to [-127,127] (ffn_vector.cpp:227-228); the -128 case must be unified across cores
Global s is passed through only; it is uncalibrated and must be maintained CPU/PS-side for dequant
LayerNorm gamma=norm1.weight and beta=norm1.bias must be cast BF16->FP32
pl_resident_ffn GELU is a 65-entry 0.25-step PWL (vision_ffn_composition max_abs ~0.0029255) while the model uses gelu_pytorch_tanh
selector metadata (source_type etc.) is not consumed by the GEMM; context rows are pooled synthetic values
All statements are interface/dimension/source inference; no end-to-end numeric or latency measurement was performed
This round implements no numerical chain
next_gate: C1 step 1 (needs separate authorization): CPU-only numeric chain dequant+LayerNorm(eps=1e-6)+Q8_0+Q8Q8(M=4K,N=3072,K=1024)+bias against a BF16/FP32 reference using real block1 slices or one streaming layer; no BD, no HLS interface change, no synthesis, no board, no GPU.
